extracted.name: Chicken Salad Wraps
extracted.description: Great picnic or lunch sandwich, with a salsa twist. For a spicier version, add some finely chopped jalapeno chile peppers! It’s a wrap!
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) cans chunk chicken, drained and flaked
instruction_lines: In a small bowl combine the chicken, onion, mayonnaise, salsa, salt and pepper. Mix together.
Line each tortilla with two lettuce leaves, then divide chicken salad mixture evenly among each tortilla and roll up, or ‘wrap’.
